aboutGame.title: What is Dragon Grove?
paragraphs: Dragon Grove is a cozy mixed-reality 3D spatial puzzle game by Schell Games, made in collaboration with Meta. Designed exclusively for Mixed Reality on Meta Quest 3 and up, it is played entirely with native hand tracking — no controller. You match and awaken magical dragon plants, foster your grove, unlock helpful dragon abilities and bond with dragons by petting, waving and cradling them with your hands.

Everyone starts with Pip, the signature green dragon, and 18 dragons total are available at launch, all unlockable through progression. The game launches free to play with 200+ levels across 30 unique groves, with more content to be announced in the official roadmap and/or patch notes. Coins earned from levels can be spent in the shop on dragon hats, tail decorations and auras, and can also be purchased; they do not expire.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dragon Grove.

items.question: What is Dragon Grove?
items.answer: Dragon Grove is a cozy mixed-reality 3D spatial puzzle game by Schell Games, made in collaboration with Meta. It is designed exclusively for Mixed Reality on Meta Quest 3 and up and is played entirely with native hand tracking. You match and awaken magical dragon plants, foster your grove, unlock helpful dragon abilities and bond with dragons.

items.question: How do I progress in Dragon Grove?
items.answer: Progress by completing the 200+ levels available at launch across 30 unique groves, earning Coins and stars along the way. Everyone starts with Pip, the signature green dragon, and the 18 dragons available at launch are all unlocked through progression.

items.question: What dragons are in Dragon Grove?
items.answer: Everyone starts with Pip, the signature green dragon. 18 dragons total are available at launch, and all are unlockable through progression. Specific dragon names and abilities beyond Pip are not documented at this time.

items.question: How do Coins work in Dragon Grove?
items.answer: Completing levels earns Coins, which are usable in the shop for dragon hats, tail decorations and auras. Coins can also be purchased and do not expire. Dragon boosts are power-ups that grant an extra match or ability use, but all levels can be completed without power-ups, so the game is not pay to win.

items.question: Is Dragon Grove free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Dragon Grove is free to play, with an expected release in spring 2027 for Meta Quest 3 headsets and up. Coins can be purchased, but all levels can be completed without power-ups.

items.question: What features are advertised for Dragon Grove?
items.answer: Official features include daily streak rewards, magical charms, meeting new dragons, tracking friends' journeys, 3D matching puzzles with new plant types, layers and spatial mechanics, and replaying groves to earn more stars. The official FAQ states the art, character assets and gameplay contain no AI components.
